events.name: ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited
events.title: H1 2026 reported results
events.source: CRON 2026-10-14: H1 2026 column added from ArcelorMittal South Africa Limited Reviewed condensed consolidated results for the six months ended 30 June 2026, income statement, from arcelormittalsa.com (issued 30 July 2026). R million stored as absolute rand: Revenue 12,038; other income 190; raw materials and consumables used 5,935; energy 2,467; movement in inventories of finished goods and work-in-progress 877; employee costs 1,421; depreciation 304; amortisation of intangible assets 7; impairment of trade and other receivables 8; other operating expenses 1,929; loss from operations 720; finance and investment income 61; finance costs 707; fair value adjustment of investment properties and asset held-for-sale 113; income after tax from equity-accounted investments 8; loss before taxation 1,245; income taxation expense 2; loss for the period 1,247; basic and diluted loss per share 112 cents. Mapping: the issuer presents by nature and prints no gross profit line, so Cost of Sales is raw materials and consumables used plus energy plus the movement in inventories of finished goods and work-in-progress, and Gross Profit is revenue less that; Operating Expenses is employee costs plus depreciation plus amortisation plus the receivables impairment plus other operating expenses, and revenue plus other income less cost of sales less operating expenses equals the printed loss from operations of 720; Net Finance Costs is finance costs less finance and investment income, and loss from operations less that plus the fair value adjustment and the equity-accounted income equals the printed loss before taxation of 1,245.

events.name: Bowler Metcalf Ltd.
events.title: FY2026 reported results
events.source: CRON 2026-10-13: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column added. Audited by Moore Cape Town Incorporated with an unmodified opinion, per the issuer's SENS short form announcement of 8 September 2026. Issuer-printed anchors: revenue 952,869 and operating profit 161,856 (R thousands, annual report financial highlights page 2); profit after tax 136,999 and earnings per share 200.20 cents (same page); profit before tax 186.7 and profit after tax 137.0 R million (SENS short form). Cost of sales 651,530 from stockanalysis.com in millions ZAR, where the same source reproduces the stored FY2025 revenue 945.851 and cost of sales 674.297 to the thousand. Derived so the printed column ties: gross profit 952,869 less 651,530 equals 301,339; operating expenses 301,339 less the printed 161,856 equals 139,483; net finance costs 161,856 less 186,720 equals minus 24,864, i.e. net finance income of 24,864 (the issuer's financial highlights define operating profit as profit before tax and net finance income); income tax 186,720 less 136,999 equals 49,721, against a source tax expense of 49.72 million. Both printed identities tie exactly on the stored column: revenue 952,869 less cost of sales 651,530 equals gross profit 301,339, and profit before tax 186,720 less income tax 49,721 equals net profit 136,999. Ratio rows for FY2026 recomputed from the FY2026 balance figures: return on equity 14.22 per cent against the 14.2 printed in the annual report highlights; gross margin 31.62 per cent and net margin 14.38 per cent, both reproducing the published figures. Source pages: https://sharedata.co.za/v2/scripts/SENS.aspx?id=559647 and https://stockanalysis.com/quote/jse/BCF/financials/income-statement/ | previous source: Yahoo Finance

events.name: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited
events.title: FY2026 reported results
events.source: Caxton and CTP Publishers and Printers Limited reviewed provisional group results for the year ended 30 June 2026, condensed consolidated statement of profit and loss and comprehensive income (SENS 11 September 2026, caxton.co.za). Figures stated in R thousands in the filing and stored here in ZAR. Net finance costs are stored negative because the group reports net finance income of 252,374. Profit before taxation 748,647 less taxation 169,001 equals profit for the year 579,646, the printed earnings per share of 162.7 cents. The 5,028 income from associates sits between operating profit and profit before taxation and is not one of the panel labels. The FY2025 and older columns are Yahoo Finance aggregations that disagree with the issuer own printed FY2025 comparatives (profit before taxation 770,682 and profit for the year 597,793); only the FY2026 column is taken from the filing.

Basic earnings per share 786.1 cents. FY2024 and older retained from Yahoo Finance: no filing read for those years.

events.name: Lesaka Technologies, Inc.
events.title: FY2026 reported results
events.source: Lesaka Technologies, Inc. consolidated statements of operations for the year ended 30 June 2026, Form 10-K and Q4 FY2026 earnings release (Nasdaq: LSAK, JSE: LSK). Figures stated in USD thousands in the filing and stored here in USD. Revenue 721,554 less cost of goods sold, IT processing, servicing and support 490,834 equals gross profit 230,720. Operating expenses 218,039 are selling general and administration 153,473 plus allowance for credit losses 12,796 plus depreciation and amortisation 47,346 plus impairment loss 4,035 plus transaction costs 389, which with operating income 12,681 reconciles. Net finance costs 15,617 are interest expense 18,506 less interest income 2,889. Income before income tax expense 3,726 less income tax 1,429 equals 2,297 net profit before equity-accounted investments; adding 215 earnings from equity-accounted investments and removing a 246 non-controlling interest loss gives 2,758 attributable to Lesaka, the basis of the printed basic earnings per share of 0.03. The FY2025 and older columns are the earlier Yahoo Finance basis; the same filing restates FY2025 and the stored FY2025 column is not restated.

events.name: Mustek Ltd.
events.title: FY2026 reported results
events.source: CRON 2026-10-13: FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column added from the issuer's results for the year ended 30 June 2026, published 30 September 2026, and the audited annual financial statements approved by the board the same week. Issuer and press printed: revenue R7.26 billion (7,256.05 million), gross profit 924.9 million, operating profit 159.8 million, finance costs 101.8 million, foreign exchange gain 52.6 million, share of associate profit 25.7 million, profit attributable to shareholders 107.6 million and basic earnings per share 198.79 cents (JSE SENS short form announcement of 30 September 2026; TechCentral, Mustek profit soars even as gross margin shrinks). Cost of sales 6,331.15 million and operating expenses 765.13 million derived from the printed revenue, gross profit and operating profit so the column ties. Net finance costs 92.84 million is the printed finance cost of 101.75 million less finance income of 8.91 million. Both printed identities tie on the stored column: revenue 7,256.05 million less cost of sales 6,331.15 million equals gross profit 924.90 million, and profit before tax 142.18 million less income tax 34.57 million equals net profit 107.61 million. Note the gap between operating profit 159.77 and profit before tax 142.18 is the equity-accounted profit, the foreign exchange gain and the loss on disposal of assets, which the panel schema does not carry as separate rows. Ratio rows for FY2026 recomputed from the FY2026 balance figures: net margin 1.48 per cent, gross margin 12.75 per cent and operating margin 2.20 per cent all reproduce the published margin figures. events.name: Northam Platinum Holdings Limited
events.title: FY2026 reported results
events.source: Operating Expenses for FY2026 and FY2025 set to 0 from the audited consolidated annual financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2026, statements of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 37: the statement carries Sales revenue 53,998,628 / 32,901,199, Cost of sales (39,845,615) / (29,307,682) and then Gross profit 14,153,013 / 3,593,517 leading straight to the impairment reversal, share of associate, investment income, finance charges, net FX, sundry income and sundry expenditure lines. There is no separately presented operating expense line because every operating cost sits inside cost of sales (operating costs, concentrates purchased, refining and other costs, depreciation and write-offs, change in metal inventory). Gross profit less the nil operating expense line reproduces the printed operating result exactly, so the row prints 0 rather than a dash. | Audited consolidated annual financial statements FY2026, statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, year ended 30 June 2026 (PricewaterhouseCoopers unmodified opinion), R000 scaled to ZAR. Cost of sales 39,845,615 is the statement's own cost of sales and carries operating costs 29,042,457, concentrates purchased 6,933,343, refining and other costs 547,287, depreciation and write-offs 1,703,206 and the change in metal inventory 1,619,322. The statement prints no separate operating expenses line, so that row is left empty rather than filled. Operating profit 14,153,013 is the figure the company itself labels operating profit in the SENS results overview (operating margin 26.2 per cent). Bridge from operating profit to profit before tax, all printed: impairment reversal at Eland 2,526,922 plus investment income 1,091,801 plus net foreign exchange gain 5,336 plus sundry income 1,034,442 less finance charges 1,343,944 less sundry expenditure 222,018 equals 17,245,552. Net finance costs row carries the printed finance charges; investment income is disclosed in this note because the panel has one finance row. Basic earnings per share 3,526.1 cents on 393,737,190 weighted shares.

Operating expenses 6,667 is employee costs 1,933 plus other operating expenses 3,723 plus amortisation and depreciation 676 plus net impairment of non-current assets 340 less fair value gain on investment properties 5, and gross profit less that figure reproduces the printed operating profit of 2,455 exactly. Net finance costs 569 is finance costs 603 less finance income 52; profit before tax is 2,455 less 569 plus share of associates 6 equals 1,892. The FY2026 column was published as reviewed and the FY2025 comparatives as audited.
